content.text: Kaluki (South African version) is a high-penalty variant of Rummy popular in South Africa. Played with two decks and four Jokers, it is distinguished by its severe scoring systemâ€”Jokers are worth 50 penalty pointsâ€”which forces players to prioritize safety and risk management over aggressive melding. It is typically a 7-round game with fixed 13-card hands.
Likely evolved from British Kalooki rules brought to South Africa by Commonwealth connections. It developed a more 'punishing' scoring profile to discourage hoarding wild cards.
Standard cards, score sheet, chips for stakes (optional).
Each player receives 13 cards. The rest go to the stock.

items.text: SA Contract: A version that uses the 9-round contract system but with SA point values.
Kummiki: A local variant with alternate Joker exchange rules.
